entries.german: Engelhard von Rosenberg des fauts sohn von Durn, öffnet denselben seine veste Mure. Or. München, staats-arch. Karlsr. Copb. 525a,275.
entries.english: Engelhard von Rosenberg, son of the Vogt of Dürn, opens his fortress Mure to the same. Original: Munich, State Archives, Karlsr. Copb. 525a,275.

facts.content: was a son of the Vogt of Dürn.
opened his fortress Mure to the persons previously mentioned in the regest.
